services.desc: The Lake Wales Arts Council is a vibrant hub of artistic expression, nestled in the heart of Florida. Boasting an array of events, the Council hosts captivating concerts featuring talented musicians from various genres, captivating audiences with spellbinding performances. The renowned Lake Wales Chorale, a harmonious ensemble of gifted community vocalists, enchants audiences with their melodic prowess and soul-stirring renditions. The LWAC creates one-night-only events that host local performers that encourage and inspire an appreciation for the performing arts. services.name: Studio 60: Pottery & Printmaking
services.desc: Studio 60 is a weekly pottery program designed for teens to explore creativity through hands-on, themed projects. Each month introduces a new source of inspiration, allowing students to build skills while experimenting with fresh ideas. Participants learn foundational hand-building techniques-including pinch, coil, and slab construction-while exploring texture, form, and surface design. Projects range from imaginative sculptures to functional ceramics and decorative pieces, encouraging self-expression, storytelling, and seasonal creativity.
